description:
Send one signed webhook.test event to one of your endpoints. The reply comes once the event is queued, not once your URL answers. A failed test counts toward switching the endpoint off, like a real event.
Use for: checking that your URL receives events and checks their signature, right after creating an endpoint.
Not for: reading whether the test arrived (get_webhook_delivery).
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: test_webhook_endpoint({"endpointId":"Wk3pQ8vN1sXr6TzL0aBc"})
Repeat: A repeat may act again on the thing as it stands then. Read it first.
Errors: endpoint_disabled; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.
name: test_webhook_endpoint
title: Send a test event
